description: The plot illustrates the validation performance of the XMoE model during training, measured by Bits Per Character (BPC) on the y-axis against Training Steps (scaled by ×10³) on the x-axis. The x-axis spans from 0 to 50 (i.e., 0 to 50,000 training steps) with major tick marks at intervals of 10, and the y-axis ranges from 1.0 to 2.25 with tick marks every 0.25 units. Two lines are plotted: one in yellow with triangle markers labeled “XMoE Validating,” and another in magenta with circle markers, also labeled “XMoE Validating” in the legend (though visually distinct, suggesting a possible duplicate label or comparison of two runs). Both lines show a sharp decline in BPC during the first 10,000 steps, with the magenta line starting at approximately 2.25 BPC and dropping to around 1.3 by 20,000 steps, while the yellow line begins slightly lower (~2.15) and converges closely with the magenta line after 20,000 steps. From 20,000 to 50,000 steps, both lines plateau near 1.15–1.2 BPC, with minor fluctuations. The magenta line exhibits slightly more volatility in the later stages, dipping below 1.15 around 40,000 steps before rising slightly again. The gridlines and legend box (grayed out) suggest this is a validation curve tracking model convergence over time.
